verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says whether Vue is governed by a foundation, a single company or an independent team, so a developer cannot assess continuity or lock-in from it. The pack shows only adjacent facts: Vue is an MIT-licensed open source project, and major changes go through a public RFC process. Neither of these discloses the governing entity or the funding model.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk
